readmeHtml:
Hyprland is a 100% independent, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.

It provides the latest Wayland features, is highly customizable, has all the eyecandy, the most powerful plugins, easy IPC, much more QoL stuff than other compositors and more...

 
 Install 
    
 Quick Start 
    
 Configure 
    
 Contribute 
 


Features

  • All of the eyecandy: gradient borders, many types of blur, animations, glow, shadows and much more
  • A lot of customization
  • 100% independent, no wlroots, no libweston, no kwin, no mutter.
  • Custom bezier and spring curves for the best animations
  • Powerful plugin support
  • Built-in plugin manager
  • Tearing support for better gaming performance
  • Easily expandable and readable codebase
  • Fast and active development
  • Not afraid to provide bleeding-edge features
  • Config reloaded instantly upon saving
  • Global keybinds passed to your apps of choice
  • Tiling/pseudotiling/floating/fullscreen windows
  • Special workspaces (scratchpads)
  • Window groups (tabbed mode)
  • Powerful window/monitor/layer rules
  • Socket-based IPC
  • Native IME and Input Panels Support
  • Fully dynamic workspaces
  • Extensive layout support
    • Dwindle
    • Scrolling
    • Master
    • Monocle
    • Custom layout with Lua
    • Custom layouts with plugins
  • Per Workspace Layouts
  • and much more...


Gallery






Special Thanks


wlroots - For powering Hyprland in the past

tinywl - For showing how 2 do stuff

Sway - For showing how 2 do stuff the overkill way

Vivarium - For showing how 2 do stuff the simple way

dwl - For showing how 2 do stuff the hacky way

Wayfire - For showing how 2 do some graphics stuff

releases.name: v0.56.2
releases.body:
A standard patch release backporting some fixes from main on top of 0.56.2.

## Fixes backported
 - algo/scrolling: fix unFSing window sticking to the left corner instead of respecting `focus_fit_method` (#15716) by @erstarr
 - config: fix duplicate config value crash (#15708) by @gulafaran
 - core/fullscreen: allow layout managed fullscreens to not block seeking window in direction, and other fixes (#15569) by @erstarr
 - core/fullscreen: fix floating window rendering order when one of them is FSed (#15703) by @erstarr
 - desktop/rules: fix gaps_out rule overriding float_gaps (#15662) by @Dregu
 - hyprctl: fix wiki strings (#15739) by @vaxerski
 - screenshare: fix toplevel capture missing software cursor (#15638) by @Dregu
 - algo/scrolling: bring back old behavior of fs (#15660) by @vaxerski
 - bindings/dispatchers: Don't inherit key state modmask during key sym lookup (#15401) by @masnax
 - config/monitorRuleManager: recheck mirrors on ensure (#15733) by @vaxerski
 - desktop/hitTest: exclusive layer popup event handling (#15729) by @aurelleb
 - desktop: render IME above all desktop components (#15646) by @vaxerski
 - feat: add missing lua stub (#15579) by @nath141

releases.body:
A big new release with tons of features and fixes, brought to you by the Hyprland Corp.

No breaking changes! :)

## New features:

 - algo/scrolling: add `inhibit_scroll` dispatch for scrolling algorithm (#13955) by @erstarr
 - algo/scrolling: add a "fit expand" layout message (#14761) by @LichtMarv
 - algo/scrolling: add new `fit_into_view` layout msg (#14991) by @erstarr
 - cm/icc: add Primaries to ICC-generated SImageDescription (#15227) by @GamingLiamStudios
 - config/lua: add a change_id workspace API (#15298) by @vaxerski
 - config/lua: add get_loaded_plugins (#14582) by @vaxerski
 - config/lua: add hl.clear_crashed_lockscreen() and fix tty instructions (#15299) by @vaxerski
 - config/lua: add is_key_down and a key event (#14779) by @zacoons
 - config/lua: add lua-driven custom live gestures (#15393) by @vaxerski

aiSummary.oneLiner: A highly customizable, independent dynamic tiling Wayland compositor emphasizing smooth animations and visual effects.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Hyprland is an independent dynamic tiling window manager and Wayland compositor that prioritizes both aesthetics and functionality. It differs from other compositors by not relying on wlroots, libweston, or mutter, offering a 100% independent implementation. It manages application windows in a tiling layout while providing visual flair typically reserved for full desktop environments, including rounded corners, dual-kawase blur, drop shadows, and fluid bezier curve animations. Hyprland allows users to extensively define their desktop experience through a simple configuration file that reloads instantly upon saving without needing to recompile the source code.
keyFeatures: Dynamic Tiling Layouts: Automatically arranges windows efficiently with built-in layouts, supporting manual placements, floating, and fullscreen windows.
Custom Bezier Animations: Provides smooth, deeply customizable bezier-curve based animations for window transitions and workspace switching.
Advanced Eyecandy: Built-in support for high-end graphical effects including gradient borders, dual-kawase blur, drop shadows, and rounded corners.
Instant Hot Reloading: Configuration changes apply instantly without requiring a system restart or code compilation.
Independent Implementation: Built entirely independently as a Wayland compositor without relying on traditional frameworks like wlroots or libweston.
Tearing Support: Includes built-in support for screen tearing, optimizing performance specifically for low-latency modern Linux gaming.
Socket-based IPC: Features powerful inter-process communication via sockets, enabling deep scriptability and external control.
Plugin Ecosystem: Supports a built-in plugin manager, allowing users to extend functionality and layouts seamlessly.

useCases.title: Custom Desktop Environments
useCases.description: Linux enthusiasts use Hyprland as the foundation to build highly personalized, aesthetically pleasing desktop setups with advanced visual effects.

useCases.title: Productivity Workflows
useCases.description: Developers leverage the dynamic tiling window management and global keybinds to maximize screen real estate and navigate efficiently via keyboard.

useCases.title: Modern Linux Gaming
useCases.description: Gamers use Hyprland for its independent low latency Wayland implementation and explicit tearing support for better performance.

useCases.title: Scripted Window Management
useCases.description: Power users utilize the socket-based IPC interface to create custom scripts that automate window placement, monitor rules, and workspace behavior.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Advanced Linux users and developers who want a keyboard-centric tiling window manager with modern visual effects and deep customizability.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Install via your distribution's package manager and edit `~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf`.
